# Tabler Vendor Assets

This folder contains a minimal local copy of Tabler assets used by
`ui/skeleton/index.html`.

- Package: `@tabler/core`
- Version: `1.4.0`
- Repository: https://github.com/tabler/tabler
- License: MIT, see `LICENSE`

Only the core CSS, theme CSS, runtime JS, package README, and license are kept
here. Example pages, flags, payment icons, and optional vendor libraries are not
included.
